DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA)

The combination of progressive gait difficulty, urinary incontinence, dysarthria, rigidity, tremor, and orthostatic hypotension strongly points to a neurodegenerative parkinsonian syndrome rather than cellulitis. The MRI and urinalysis results are consistent with this clinical picture, confirming a diagnosis of Multiple System Atrophy.
